note: Smoke profile attempted by the ops verifier on 2026-11-01: corpus generated partially, load runs not executed (see profiles.smoke.limitations); reference_10m and scale_100m remain deferred and unmeasured.

smoke.environment: macOS 27.2 Apple Silicon (8 cores, 24 GiB host; Docker Desktop VM 8 CPUs / 7.6 GiB shared with the containers of three other Blackbox projects), Docker 27.3.1, images blackbox/*:0.1.0-rc6 on the ops install (project blackbox-agent-c-ops, 127.0.0.1:19185); during the run the host was saturated by other agents' workloads (load average 700-840 on 8 cores, 14.7 GiB swap in use) and the Docker VM load average was 40-60; docker commands took minutes
commands: PGHOST=127.0.0.1 PGPORT=19186 PGDATABASE=blackbox PGUSER=bb_api PGPASSWORD_FILE=<install>/secrets/pg_api_password target/release/corpus --seed 42 --tenants 50 --min-entries 250000 --min-orders 10000 --parallel 6 --manifest reports/evidence/PILOT-09/corpus-manifest.json  (corpus-v2, stopped after ~43 min; see corpus-generation.txt)

NOT EXECUTED: node tests/perf/prepare.mjs ...; node tests/perf/smoke.mjs --mode closed|fixed --transport api|mcp --duration 600 ...; node tests/perf/verdict.mjs ...; node tests/perf/report.mjs ... (driver, verdict and report scripts are committed and syntax-checked but no load run happened: the api of the ops install was unreachable on its published port until the rc6b upgrade (LOCAL-05 defect) and the upgrade itself was still loading images on the saturated host when the run was wrapped up)

dataset.note: generator stopped before the largest tenant was complete: 50 tenants and 348,233 five-track entries exist (above the 250k minimum) but only 6,305 distinct orders (minimum 10,000) and the largest tenant holds 20.7% of the orders (required 50%); one orphan tenant from an aborted sequential run is excluded

engine_observed_during_generation.note: engine /health read from inside the api container while the corpus was applied on the saturated host; the 1024 MiB steady target would not hold at this RSS (structural budget 512 MiB, two copies per tenant); not a load-run measurement

ingestion_observed.append_journal_entries_rate_per_connecti: ~50 (single connection, PostgreSQL CPU-bound) rising to ~300 with 6 concurrent tenants before the host saturated
ingestion_observed.note: generator-side measurement through the same append_journal_entries(jsonb) boundary the API uses; not the 20 entries/s replay-API workload of the contract

measurements.engine_only_sample: docs/engine.md measured sample 2026-11-01 (release binary p50 55.8 ms / p95 125.3 ms / p99 162.1 ms engine RPC only, 16 clients over 2 workspaces); not the API/MCP measurement

limitations: No per-class API/MCP latency, success fraction, lag, memory, restart, rebuild or restore measurement exists: every smoke target is unmeasured and the gate is not passed.

The corpus does not meet the dataset minimums (orders 6,305 < 10,000; largest tenant 20.7% < 50%); the manifest was reconstructed from the database after the generator was stopped and its hot/cold sets are drawn by hash order, not by the generator RNG.

Host conditions were not representative of the reference host: other agents ran Playwright/Docker workloads concurrently (load average 700-840, 14.7 GiB swap); a repeat on a quiet host with the committed scripts (tests/perf/*.mjs) is required before any number is reported.

The ops install was on rc6 images whose api rejected every request on a non-default published port (defect fixed in the working tree, rc6b image); the upgrade to rc6b was still in progress at wrap-up.
